20th Term from the End of an arithmetic progression, Class 10 board exam: find it for 3, 8, 13, …, 253 by reversing the AP.

• Reverse the AP: first term 253, common difference −5
• aₙ = a + (n − 1)d
• a₂₀ = 253 + 19 × (−5) = 253 − 95 = 158
